issues: 米白页面平铺满屏，卡片小、没有舞台与光，看起来是一张截图在横移
变速只能靠模糊程度去猜，画面上没有任何东西告诉观众「现在放慢了」
慢窗里目标卡只抬高一点点，凝视的对象不够突出，其余卡仍然抢视线
全程停在快速流动里收尾，尾帧是一张糊掉的画面，没有落定的海报
changes: look 换成 aurora 紫夜：真实卡片纹理立在有倒影的玻璃导轨上，背后地平线光带 + 顶部薰衣草主光
变速写在画面上：左下 150px 速率读数随 remap 斜率实时变化（慢窗转粉 + 泛光），右下速率-帧曲线带播放头，走过的部分点亮、凝视窗描粉
速率曲线改为 2.6→0.2→2.6→0 三段 smoothstep 换挡，每源帧位移反推到刹停时恰好一张卡停在屏中，尾段 22f 静止海报
凝视：目标卡拾起 22px + 放大 5% + 粉色轮廓光与地面余光，其余卡压进紫黑、相机极缓推近 2.5%，卡上挂「0.2× · IN FOCUS」标签
快段背景随速度出现横向光痕，慢窗光痕消失、画面安静；方向性模糊仍按实际速度门控
时长 135f → 170f（快 30f / 刹车 18f / 凝视 48f / 油门 14f / 快 14f / 刹停 24f / hold 22f）
issuesEn: A cream page filled the frame edge to edge; the cards were small with no stage or light, so it read as a screenshot sliding sideways
You could only guess at the speed change from the blur; nothing on screen said the shot had slowed down
In the slow window the target card barely lifted, so the gaze had no clear subject and the other cards still competed
It ended mid-flow, so the last frame was a blurred image instead of a settled poster
changesEn: Aurora look (violet night): the real card textures stand on a reflective glass rail, with a horizon glow band and a lavender key light from above

The speed change is on screen: a 150px playback-rate readout tracks the remap slope live (it turns pink and glows in the slow window), and a rate-over-frame curve with a playhead lights up as it plays, with the gaze window traced in pink
The rate curve is now 2.6→0.2→2.6→0 with three smoothstep shifts; pixels per source frame are solved so a card comes to rest dead centre, giving a 22f still poster at the end
Gaze: the target card lifts 22px, scales up 5% and gets a pink rim and floor glow, the rest sink into violet-black, the camera pushes in 2.5%, and a '0.2× · IN FOCUS' tag sits above the card
Horizontal light streaks appear behind the rail at speed and vanish in the slow window; directional blur is still gated on real velocity
135f → 170f (fast 30f / brake 18f / gaze 48f / throttle 14f / fast 14f / stop 24f / hold 22f)
